made.method_in_its_record: built-in image generation, from the photo and the prompt

prompt: Create one square seamless base-color game material texture, 1024 square or higher. Reference image is New City Gas Montreal; use ONLY the irregular grey rubble masonry infill between the windows, not dressed rectangular stone trims nor red brick. Faithful naturalistic interpretation of uneven flattened grey stone faces, small irregular stones and larger roughly horizontal stones, pale grey mortar, subtle weathering. Front-on orthographic isolated wall surface filling entire frame; approximately 1.5 metre patch, interpreted scale. Remove directional illumination and deep cast shadows; flat diffuse neutral daylight, no occlusions, windows, plants, borders, text or labels. Preserve irregular stone identity, do not turn it into regular ashlar. Seamless edges requested. This is an authored reference-based reconstruction, not a scientific measurement.
study_note: Lithology is unverified. The 2011 photo does not establish present condition. Generated stones are more regularly coursed than some source areas. A generated height attempt changed the layout and was rejected.
scale_note: Suggested 1.5 m square for prototype comparison only.
